# audio_games_vowels

Eight cardinal vowels, each sung steadily for about 0.6 s by one adult male speaker, for the formant analyser and the vowel games ([#866](https://github.com/thorwhalen/thoremin/issues/866)). The same recordings glossa plays for these vowels.

| File | IPA | Commons file |
|---|---|---|
| `i.wav` | [i] close front unrounded | `Close_front_unrounded_vowel.ogg` |
| `e.wav` | [e] close-mid front unrounded | `Close-mid_front_unrounded_vowel.ogg` |
| `epsilon.wav` | [ɛ] open-mid front unrounded | `Open-mid_front_unrounded_vowel.ogg` |
| `a.wav` | [a] open front unrounded | `Open_front_unrounded_vowel.ogg` |
| `alpha.wav` | [ɑ] open back unrounded | `Open_back_unrounded_vowel.ogg` |
| `open-o.wav` | [ɔ] open-mid back rounded | `Open-mid_back_rounded_vowel.ogg` |
| `o.wav` | [o] close-mid back rounded | `Close-mid_back_rounded_vowel.ogg` |
| `u.wav` | [u] close back rounded | `Close_back_rounded_vowel.ogg` |

Each is mono, 22.05 kHz, 16-bit, converted from the Commons Ogg Vorbis by `scripts/audio_games/fetch_vowels.sh test/fixtures/audio_games_vowels`.
